     1	import dlt
     2	from pyspark.sql.functions import col, trim, to_date
     3	from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
     4	
     5	spark = SparkSession.getActiveSession()
     6	catalog = spark.conf.get("catalog")
     7	target_schema = spark.conf.get("target_schema")  # silver target schema, e.g., consumer_order_silver
     8	# Derive bronze schema from silver target
     9	bronze_schema = target_schema.replace("_silver", "_bronze")
    10	bronze_table = f"{catalog}.{bronze_schema}.consumer_order_mv"
    11	# Parent consumer table for referential integrity check (parent entity: consumer)
    12	# Derive parent silver schema by replacing "_order_silver" with "_silver"
    13	parent_schema = target_schema.replace("_order_silver", "_silver")
    14	parent_table = f"{catalog}.{parent_schema}.consumer_mv"
    15	
    16	@dlt.expect_or_drop("valid_fk_consumer_order_to_consumer", "parent_consumer_id IS NOT NULL")
    17	@dlt.expect_or_drop("valid_order_id", "order_id IS NOT NULL")
    18	@dlt.table(
    19	    name="consumer_order_mv",
    20	    comment="Silver consumer_order view with cleaned data",
    21	    table_properties={"quality": "silver"},
    22	    schema="""
    23	        order_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    24	        consumer_id INT,
    25	        order_date DATE,
    26	        order_status STRING,
    27	        total_amount DOUBLE,
    28	        currency STRING,
    29	        payment_method STRING,
    30	        channel STRING,
    31	        billing_address STRING,
    32	        shipping_address STRING,
    33	        parent_consumer_id INT
    34	    """
    35	)
    36	def consumer_order_mv():
    37	    # Read from bronze table as a batch source
    38	    df = spark.read.table(bronze_table)
    39	    # Trim whitespace from string columns
    40	    string_cols = ["order_status", "currency", "payment_method", "channel", "billing_address", "shipping_address"]
    41	    for c in string_cols:
    42	        df = df.withColumn(c, trim(col(c)))
    43	    # Convert order_date to date type
    44	    df = df.withColumn("order_date", to_date(col("order_date"), "yyyy-MM-dd"))
    45	    # Referential integrity check: validate consumer_id references consumer.consumer_mv
    46	    parent_df = spark.read.table(parent_table).select(col("consumer_id").alias("parent_consumer_id"))
    47	    df = df.join(parent_df, df["consumer_id"] == parent_df["parent_consumer_id"], "left")
    48	    return df
